blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Building change detection (BCD) relies on dense annotations that are costly to collect across regions. A few annotated examples offer a more economical way to specify the target, but change maps provide incomplete building supervision: they label only changed buildings and leave the building-containing date unspecified. Our key observation is that these annotations nevertheless reveal features that recognize buildings in other images, including unchanged ones. We present Linear INduced Discriminants (LIND), a training-free framework that turns regional feature contrasts into a reusable linear building classifier. Using a single frozen vision transformer, it unifies building recognition and temporal comparison in the same feature space. This approach requires neither text prompts nor an auxiliary segmentation model. Only one parameter is tuned on a single validation dataset and then kept fixed across datasets and shot settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong detection accuracy, cross-dataset transfer, and efficient inference, with extensions to other semantic classes and broader land-cover changes. Change annotations thus provide a compact visual specification for detection in new scenes. Code: https://github.com/lzcn/lind
blocks.zh: 建筑变化检测(BCD)依赖于密集的注解,跨区域收集成本高昂. 几个附加说明的例子提供了更经济的方式来指定目标,但更动图提供了不完整的建筑监督:它们只给已改变的建筑贴上标签,并留下含有建筑物的日期未注明. 我们的主要看法是,这些说明揭示了在其他图像中识别建筑物的特征,包括没有改变的建筑物。 将区域特征对比转化为可重复使用的线性建筑分类器。 它使用单个被冷冻的视变器,统一同一地物空间的建筑物识别和时间比较. 这种方法既不需要文字提示,也不需要辅助分块模型. 只有一个参数在单一的验证数据集上调取,然后固定在数据集和射击设置之间. 广泛的实验显示探测精度高,跨数据集转移和高效推论,并扩展到了其他语义类和更广泛的土地覆盖变化. 因此,更改说明为在新场景中检测提供了一个紧凑的视觉规格。 代码:https://github.com/lzcn/lind (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Building change detection (BCD) identifies construction and demolition from images acquired at different times, supporting urban monitoring, infrastructure management, and disaster assessment [ 8 , 25 ] . Supervised detectors achieve strong performance [ 7 , 14 , 3 , 15 ] , but obtaining their labels requires comparing both dates and delineating genuine changes amid appearance variation. Extending monitoring to new regions also introduces differences in building appearance and seasonal conditions that challenge generalization [ 40 , 19 ] . An effective detector should therefore make economical use of annotations while remaining applicable beyond the scenes from which they were collected.
blocks.zh: 建筑物变化探测(BCD)识别不同时间获取的图像的施工和拆除,支持城市监测,基础设施管理和灾害评估[8,25]. 监督的探测器实现强性能[7,14,3,15],但获得它们的标签需要同时比较日期和在外观变异时划定真实变化. 将监测范围扩大到新区域也带来了建筑外观和季节性条件的差异,对一般化提出了挑战[40,19]. 因此,有效的探测器应经济地使用说明,同时在收集说明的场景之外继续适用。

blocks.en: Foundation models offer an opportunity to meet these requirements by reusing representations learned through large-scale pretraining [ 36 , 34 , 27 , 23 ] . Adapting the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to change detection enables training-free change localization [ 56 , 42 ] . Category-specific detection additionally requires relating temporal differences to the target concept. Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) addresses this by using language to specify the target category [ 26 , 12 , 57 ] . This flexibility depends on grounding a category description in the image. For buildings, a description can convey the object category while leaving roof appearance and spatial extent underspecified. Prompt and refinement settings suited to one region may also transfer poorly to another. Many systems additionally combine recognition, segmentation, and temporal comparison through intermediate masks or category assignments, allowing errors to propagate between stages [ 12 , 17 ] . These limitations motivate a more direct connection between specifying the target and detecting its changes.
blocks.zh: 基金会模式提供了一个机会,通过重新使用通过大规模预先培训获得的陈述[36、34、27、23]来满足这些要求。 调整分块任意模式(SAM)以改变检测,使得培训无限制的改变本地化[56,42]. 具体类别的检测还需要将时间差异与目标概念联系起来。 开放式变换检测(OVCD)通过使用语言来指定目标类别[26,12,57]来解决这个问题. 这种灵活性取决于在图像中设置一个类别描述。 对于建筑物,一种描述可以传达物体的类别,同时留下屋顶外观和空间范围不够精确. 迅速和完善适合一个区域的环境也可能向另一个区域转移不良。 许多系统还通过中间口罩或类别任务将识别、分割和时间比较结合起来,使错误在[12、17]阶段之间传播。 这些限制促使在指定目标与发现目标变化之间建立更直接的联系。

blocks.en: Annotated examples provide a concrete visual specification through the target’s appearance and extent. Visual prompting and example-conditioned segmentation demonstrate the value of this interface [ 45 , 11 , 28 ] . Few-shot change detection also uses annotated example pairs, but trains a task-specific network to interpret them [ 4 ] . We study how these examples can define a detector directly in frozen features, without task-specific training. Our starting observation is that features pooled from an annotated change region respond to buildings in other images, including unchanged ones, as shown in Fig. 1 . A change annotation therefore exposes reusable building information beyond the particular transition it labels. This motivates constructing a building classifier from change examples and applying it to new scenes.
blocks.zh: 附加说明的例子通过目标外观和范围提供了具体的视觉说明。 视觉提示和以实例为条件的分割显示此接口的价值[45, 11, 28]. 很少镜头的更改检测也使用附加说明的例对,但训练一个任务特定的网络来解释[4]. 我们研究这些例子如何在不进行具体任务培训的情况下,直接用冷冻特性定义探测器。 我们的最初观察是,从附加说明的改变区域集合起来的特征是对其他图像中的建筑物的反应,包括图1所示的不变的建筑物。 因此,修改注释会暴露出超出其标记的特定过渡范围的可重复使用的建筑信息。 这推动了从变化实例构建一个建筑分类器并将其应用到新的场景.

blocks.en: Extracting this information requires resolving the ambiguity of change annotations. A change map marks where a building appeared or disappeared but does not identify which date contains the building. The same pixels may be a building in one date and its surroundings in the other, and unchanged buildings outside the mask remain mixed with the background. The marked region and its complement therefore cannot serve as complete foreground and background labels. The central challenge is to recover a building-separating direction from these incomplete temporal annotations.
blocks.zh: 提取这些信息需要解决变化说明的模糊性. 一处建筑物出现或消失的变更地图标记,但不指明该建筑物的日期。 同样的像素可能是一个日期的建筑,而它的周围在另一个日期,面具外的不变建筑仍然与背景混杂在一起. 因此,标记区域及其补充不能作为完整的前景和背景标签。 中心挑战是从这些不完整的时间说明中恢复一个分隔建筑的方向。

blocks.en: We present Linear INduced Discriminants (LIND), a training-free BCD framework conditioned on change-annotated example pairs. Our key idea is to turn the contrast between an annotated region and its surroundings into a reusable building discriminant. Regional contrasts provide both a cue to the building-containing date and a direction that separates buildings from their context. This construction uses incomplete change annotations to specify a linear decision rule directly, without learning a prediction head or requiring complete building masks. The resulting classifier can recognize both changed and unchanged buildings, allowing temporal comparison to focus on the target category.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍的是线性诱导歧视者(LIND),这是一个无培训的碱性催化分解框架,以附加说明的对例为条件。 我们的主要想法是,把附加说明的区域与其周围的对比变为可重复使用的歧视性建筑。 区域对比既为建房日期提供了提示,也为建筑与建筑背景区分开来。 这种构造使用不完整的更改说明直接指定一个线性决定规则,而不学习一个预测头或者需要完整的建筑口罩. 由此形成的分类器既可以识别已改变的建筑,也可以识别未改变的建筑,从而可以对目标类别进行时间比较.

blocks.en: Recognizable building responses must also support consistent change decisions across scenes. Response levels can vary with the example and query, while small registration errors can compare different structures across dates. We formulate change scoring as a comparison of building responses and feature dissimilarity, accounting for response variation and local misalignment within each query pair [ 31 , 29 ] . In Fig. 1 , the final scores suppress unchanged buildings across the two queries while emphasizing changed regions. Building recognition and change scoring thus operate within the same frozen feature space.
blocks.zh: 显而易见的建筑对策还必须支持在全场作出一致的变革决定。 响应级别可以随示例和查询而变化,而小的注册错误可以比较不同日期的不同结构. 我们制定变化评分,作为构建反应和特征差异的比较,说明反应变化和每个查询对[31,29]中的局部错配。 在图1中,最后的分数压制了两个查询中不变的建筑物,同时强调变化的区域. 因此,建筑识别和改变评分在同一冻结的地物空间内运作。

blocks.en: Our method requires no text prompts, auxiliary segmentation models, or clustering. Its only validation-selected parameter is a decision margin, fixed across datasets and shot settings. Experiments demonstrate accurate detection, cross-dataset transfer, and efficient inference, while building recognition confirms that change annotations provide information beyond the marked transitions.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法不需要文字提示,辅助分区模型,或集群. 它唯一的验证选择参数是一个决定比值,固定在数据集和射击设置之间. 实验证明了准确的检测,跨数据集传输,以及高效的推论,而建筑识别则证实变化说明提供了超过标记过渡的信息.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • To the best of our knowledge, we introduce the first training-free BCD framework conditioned directly on change-annotated image pairs, using examples to specify the detector without task-specific learning. • We propose a simple yet effective algorithm that resolves temporal ambiguity and incomplete building supervision through regional feature contrasts, producing a linear discriminant for building recognition and change detection. • Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the compared training-free methods on LEVIR-CD and WHU-CD, strong cross-dataset transfer, and fast, memory-efficient inference with one validation-selected margin.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 就我们所知,我们采用第一个无培训的碱性催化分解框架,直接以变化附加说明的图像对为条件,使用实例来指定探测器,而不进行特定任务的学习。 我们提出一个简单而有效的算法,通过区域特征对比来解决时间模糊和建筑监督不完整的问题,产生一个线性歧视因素,用于建筑识别和变化检测。 · 广泛的实验显示LEVIR-CD和WHU-CD的比较无培训方法中最先进的性能,强跨数据集传输,以及快速、高效的内存推论,一个验证选定比值。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Supervised Change Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 监督的变化检测

blocks.en: Classical change detectors compare handcrafted spectral or statistical features [ 30 , 32 , 6 ] . They require no training but depend on threshold selection and are sensitive to radiometric variation. Supervised models learn temporal representations from annotated image pairs for change localization [ 10 ] and description [ 2 ] . Siamese networks encode both dates with shared weights [ 5 , 15 ] , while attention and transformer blocks model spatial and temporal interactions [ 8 , 7 , 3 , 14 , 9 ] . Boundary refinement improves spatial detail [ 20 ] , and semantic variants predict land-cover transitions [ 55 ] .
blocks.zh: 古典变化探测器比较手动光谱或统计特征[30,32,6]. 它们不需要培训,但取决于阈值选择,而且对辐射测量变化敏感。 监督模型从附加说明的图像对学习时间表示,以改变本地化[10]和描述[2]. 暹罗网络编码了两个有共享权重的日期[5,15],而注意区块和变压器区块则模拟了空间和时间相互作用[8,7,3,14,9]. 边界完善改善空间细节[20],语义变体预测土地覆盖过渡[55].

blocks.en: These models achieve strong in-domain accuracy but depend on the training distribution. Domain adaptation and self-training reduce this dependence by adapting to target-related data or exploiting unlabeled imagery [ 40 , 19 , 54 , 21 ] . Few-shot and partial-supervision methods further reduce annotation requirements [ 4 , 50 , 1 ] . These methods retain task-specific learning.
blocks.zh: 这些模型实现了很强的域内精确度,但取决于培训的分布。 领域适应和自我培训通过适应目标相关数据或利用无标签图像来减少这种依赖性[40、19、54、21]。 少发和部分监督方法进一步减少了注释要求[4,50,1]. 这些方法保留了针对特定任务的学习.

blocks.en: 2.2 Foundation-Model Change Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 基础-模型变化探测

blocks.en: Frozen foundation models provide dense representations for temporal comparison without task-specific training. AnyChange uses SAM features and bitemporal latent matching to produce class-agnostic change maps, with point queries specifying objects of interest [ 56 ] . UCD-SCM applies a frozen segmentation model to building change detection and adds feature recalibration and semantic attention [ 42 ] . Other pipelines use SAM proposals or reconstruction to localize changes [ 18 , 33 ] . Feature dissimilarity provides a general change signal, while category-specific detection additionally requires identifying the target concept.
blocks.zh: 冻结的基础模型为时间比较提供了密集的表述,而不进行具体任务的培训。 AnyChange 使用 SAM 特性和位元潜在匹配来生成类不可知变化图,点查询指定感兴趣的对象 [56]. UCD-SCM在建筑变化检测中采用了冷冻分解模型,并增加了特征重新校正和语义注意[42]. 其他管道使用SAM提案或重建使变化本地化[18,33]. 特征差异性提供了一般的改变信号,而特定类别的检测还需要识别目标概念.

blocks.en: Open-vocabulary change detection supplies this category information through language and pretrained recognition models [ 26 , 58 ] . AdaptOVCD and ReA-OVCD combine semantic recognition with segmentation and temporal comparison [ 12 , 57 ] . MemOVCD and CoRegOVCD incorporate temporal memory and consistency or geometric cues [ 24 , 43 ] . OmniOVCD combines semantic and instance outputs within SAM 3 [ 53 ] . OpenDPR retrieves proposals against diffusion-generated visual prototypes [ 17 ] , and Seg2Change adapts an open-vocabulary segmentation model to bitemporal comparison [ 41 ] . Target specification and temporal comparison are linked through masks, category assignments, or prototypes. Robustness depends on both semantic grounding and the consistency of these intermediate outputs across dates.
blocks.zh: 开放式变换检测通过语言和预训识别模型提供这一类信息[26,58]. 适应OVCD和ReA-OVCD结合语义识别与分化和时间比较[12,57]. MemOVCD和CoRegOVCD包含时间内存和一致性或几何提示[24,43]. OmniOVCD在SAM 3 [53]中结合语义和实例输出. OpenDPR针对扩散生成的视觉原型检索提案[17],Seg2Change调整开放-vocabulary分区模型,以进行位点比较[41]. 目标规格和时间比较通过口罩,类别任务或原型连接起来. 稳健性既取决于语义基础,也取决于这些中期产出跨日期的一致性。

blocks.en: 2.3 In-Context Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.3 内容分割

blocks.en: In-context segmentation uses annotated image–mask examples to specify the target in a query image. Examples specify both target appearance and spatial extent. Few-shot methods learn prototype matching or feature interactions [ 44 ] , while pretrained models enable inference from examples without task-specific training [ 52 , 46 , 28 ] . Recent approaches operate directly on frozen features. INSID3 groups features into regions [ 11 ] , REBASE uses reference and background subspaces [ 16 ] , FSSDINO constructs class prototypes [ 49 ] , and FROST compares foreground and background densities [ 35 ] . Their example masks generally identify the target in a particular image. Change maps introduce an additional ambiguity by marking a transition without identifying the building-containing date or labeling unchanged buildings. Our method uses regional contrasts to recover a building discriminant from these annotations and compare its responses across dates.
blocks.zh: 内文本分割使用附加说明的图像 - mask 示例在查询图像中指定目标 。 实例说明目标外观和空间范围。 少有的镜头方法学习原型匹配或特征互动[44],而经过预先训练的模型则能够从没有特定任务训练的例子中推论[52,46,28]. 最近的办法直接适用于冻结的特性。 INSID3组特征为区域[11],REBASE使用参考和背景子空间[16],FSSDINO构建类原型[49],FROST比较前缘和背景密度[35]. 他们的榜样面具一般在特定图像中识别目标. 改变地图增加了模糊性,在过渡时未标明含有建筑物的日期或标示没有改变的建筑物。 我们的方法利用区域对比,从这些说明中收回一幢歧视性建筑,并比较其不同日期的答复。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our key idea is to construct a linear building discriminant directly from annotated examples in a frozen feature space, without task-specific training. Fig. 2 illustrates the two stages of our method. Regional feature contrasts within the examples define the discriminant. Its responses on a query pair, weighted by temporal feature dissimilarity, identify building changes.

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate building change detection on LEVIR-CD [ 8 ] , WHU-CD [ 22 ] , and S2Looking [ 38 ] , with SECOND [ 48 ] and DSIFN-CD [ 51 ] extending the evaluation to other semantic classes and broader land-cover changes. LEVIR-CD contains 637 image pairs at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 pixels, officially split into 445 training, 64 validation, and 128 test pairs. WHU-CD provides 1,260 training and 690 test pairs at 512 × 512 512\times 512 , with no official validation split. S2Looking contains 5,000 side-looking satellite pairs at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 , officially split into 3,500 training, 500 validation, and 1,000 test pairs. SECOND labels six land-cover classes in 4,662 pairs at 512 × 512 512\times 512 , with 2,968 training and 1,694 test pairs and no validation split. DSIFN-CD labels general land-cover changes in 3,988 pairs at 512 × 512 512\times 512 , officially split into 3,600 training, 340 validation, and 48 test pairs. We remove duplicates from its augmented training and validation sets.

We call this the K K -shot setting and evaluate K ∈ { 1 , 5 , 10 } K\in\{1,5,10\} . We report foreground IoU and F1 as percentages, computed from pooled pixel counts.

blocks.en: S2Looking tests transfer from aerial scenes to side-looking satellite imagery. In Table 3 , our method outperforms the compared OVCD baselines with 5-shot or 10-shot source examples. Target examples further improve performance without changing the decision margin. Source examples retain useful building information across datasets, while target examples better represent local appearance.
blocks.zh: S2外观试验从空中场景转移到侧视卫星图像. 在表3中,我们的方法以5发或10发源的例子超过了比较的OVCD基线。 目标实例在不改变决定幅度的情况下进一步改善业绩。 原始实例保留了各种数据集的有用的构建信息,而目标实例则更好地代表了本地的外观。

blocks.en: 4.4 Extension to Other Changes
blocks.zh: 4.4 其他变动的延伸

blocks.en: To assess applicability beyond building change detection, we evaluate diverse land-cover transitions on DSIFN-CD and changes involving other semantic classes on SECOND.
blocks.zh: 为了评估建筑变化探测以外的适用性,我们评价了DSIFN-CD上的各种土地覆盖过渡,以及涉及第二期其他语义课的变化。

blocks.en: Land-cover changes. DSIFN-CD combines diverse land-cover transitions in a binary change map. To represent these transitions directly, we construct prototypes from temporal feature differences, denoted as Ours † in Table 5 . The encoder, example sampling, and decision margin remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 土地覆被变化. DSIFN-CD结合了二进制变化图中的各种土地覆盖过渡. 为了直接代表这些过渡,我们从时间特征差异中构建原型,在表5中表示“我们的”。 编码器、样本和决定幅度保持不变。

blocks.en: Both evaluations use 10-shot examples. The full-set evaluation pools the deduplicated training, validation, and test splits, drawing each query’s examples from the remaining pairs. Change-vector prototypes improve both evaluations in Table 5 , indicating that temporal differences better represent these diverse transitions than a single building direction.
blocks.zh: 两次评价都使用10个镜头的例子。 完全设定的评价集合了破解的训练、验证和测试分解,从剩下的对中抽取每个查询的例子。 变革推动者原型改进了表5中的两个评价,表明时间差异比单一建筑方向更能反映这些不同的转变。

blocks.en: Other semantic classes. SECOND tests whether examples can specify target categories beyond buildings. It covers six land-cover classes, including buildings, trees, and water. Each class reuses one 10-shot example set for all queries.
blocks.zh: 其他语义类. 第二次测试实例是否能够指定建筑物以外的目标类别。 它包括六个土地覆盖阶层,包括建筑物、树木和水。 每类都对所有查询重用一个10发的示例.

Mean F1 rises from 46.93% to 54.90%, with gains in five of six classes and the largest gain on playgrounds. blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: We assess discriminant construction and query scoring by removing six components individually in Table 7 : (a) ring, (b) exterior contrast, (c) scale normalization, (d) registration compensation, (e) boundary calibration, and (f) distance weighting. For (f), we reselect τ \tau on LEVIR-CD validation.
blocks.zh: 我们评估歧视性建筑和查询评分,在表7中分别删除六个组成部分:(a) 环;(b) 外部对比;(c) 规模正常化;(d) 登记补偿;(e) 边界校准;(f) 距离加权。 对于(f),我们在LEVIR-CD验证上重新选择\tau。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Ablation study (F1).
blocks.zh: 表7:关系研究(F1).

blocks.en: Interior–exterior contrast is central to discriminant construction: removing it reduces F1. The ring gives modest gains. An interior prototype can retrieve buildings, but exterior contrast makes the response relative to the surrounding scene. The larger loss from removing this contrast, compared with removing the ring, separates the central discriminative mechanism from the refinement provided by local context. When σ \sigma varies little across examples, its effect can largely be absorbed by retuning τ \tau .
blocks.zh: 内部 - 外部对比是歧视性建筑的核心:拆除它会减少F1. 环能略增益. 一个内部原型可以回收建筑物,但外部对比使得反应相对周围的场景. 与移除环相比,去除这一反差损失较大,使得中央歧视机制与本地环境提供的完善脱节. 当\sigma在实例上差异不大时,它的效果在很大程度上可以通过重调\\tau来吸收.

blocks.en: Query scoring improves robustness to response variation and spatial mismatch. Calibration helps most at 1-shot, while registration compensation gives larger gains on WHU-CD. In Table 8 , compensation reduces false positives under synthetic token shifts on unchanged validation pairs. Local matches reduce changes falsely attributed to spatial offsets. These effects address different sources of uncertainty: calibration adjusts the response offset inherited from the examples, whereas matching improves temporal correspondence. Their relative gains vary across settings because example variability and spatial misalignment need not be equally pronounced.
blocks.zh: 查询评分提高了响应变异性和空间不匹配性. 校准最有助于1发子弹,而注册补偿则能对WHU-CD产生更大的收益. 在表8中,补偿减少在未改变的验证对上合成代币转换时的假阳性。 局部匹配减少误认为空间抵消的变化。 这些效应解决了不确定性的不同来源:校准调整了从实例中继承下来的反应,而匹配则改善了时间对应. 它们的相对收益因环境而异,因为例子的可变性和空间错位不一定都一样明显。

blocks.en: Backbone comparison. We assess the role of frozen representations by varying the encoder and pretraining data in Table 9 . DINOv3-L [ 39 ] outperforms DINOv2-L [ 34 ] , while its satellite-pretrained weights perform worse than its general-image weights. Pretraining on remote sensing imagery alone therefore does not ensure features suited to the induced discriminant. Regional means must provide a distinct building direction that remains useful across images. Matching the pretraining domain is less informative than measuring how the resulting features separate buildings from their surroundings.
blocks.zh: 背骨比较. 我们通过改变表9中的编码器和预培训数据来评估冻结表述的作用。 DINOv3-L[39] 表现优于DINov2-L[34],而其卫星预培训重量表现比一般图像重量差。 因此,仅仅对遥感图像进行预先培训并不能确保特征适合诱导的歧视行为人。 区域手段必须提供独特的建设方向,在图像中仍然有用。 匹配预训域比测量由此形成的特征如何将建筑物与周围环境区分开来的信息较少.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented LIND, a training-free framework that turns change-annotated examples into a linear building discriminant using one frozen vision transformer. Regional feature contrasts recover building information beyond the annotated transitions, enabling recognition and change detection in the same feature space. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong detection and cross-dataset transfer, efficient inference, and applicability to other semantic classes and land-cover changes. With one validation-selected margin, this simple framework offers a practical alternative to task-specific training. Its effectiveness depends on example coverage and frozen features that preserve building identity across scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了LIND,一个无培训框架,它利用一个冷冻的视觉变压器,把附加说明的变换实例变成一个线性建筑歧视者。 区域特征对比了修复附加说明的过渡之外的建筑信息,使得在同一特征空间中能够识别和检测变化. 广泛的实验显示出强大的探测和跨数据集转移,有效的推论,以及适用于其他语义类和土地覆盖的变化. 这一简单的框架以一个选定的验证幅度,为具体任务的培训提供了一个实际的替代办法。 其有效性取决于能保护整个场景的建筑特性的范例覆盖和冻结特征。
